rationale: The assistant correctly read dE as a door problem and asked sensible door questions, but when the customer handed it the answer - a king-size duvet bulging against the glass with a corner squashed in the seal, door springing back - it ignored this entirely and declared 'Cause not confirmed', escalating to an engineer. The right step was trivially to say the drum is overloaded and to remove the duvet and retry; instead a UK homeowner would be sent to pay for an unnecessary callout. No fabrication, no unsafe advice and no part pushed, but fidelity to the customer's evidence and escalation judgement were poor.
